events.title: Early Access Release Slightly Delayed
events.summary: Hello folks, Turrer here. I have an update regarding the Early Access release.To make Act 1 as complete as possible, including all levels, bosses, and the full soundtrack, we’ve decided to include Phase 2 before launch.
